cards.card: Visa Privilege Infinite in Kuwaiti Dinar
Visa Privilege Infinite in US Dollar

note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): National Bank of Kuwait, Kuwait Finance House and Commercial Bank of Kuwait. National Bank of Kuwait's consumer tariff list (dated 05/10/2026) was read: it gives each card's issuance and annual fee, a 5% cash withdrawal fee, a 2.75% foreign exchange mark-up and past-due fees, but prices what's carried as 2.5% over the Central Bank of Kuwait's discount rate plus 0.5% a month, and the discount rate's own page (cbk.gov.kw) answered not found, so no NBK card is written: a card's rate can't be left out. Kuwait Finance House's card page showed no terms to this research and wasn't written. Commercial Bank of Kuwait (Al-Tijari): its Mastercard fees and limits page, read in full on 2026-10-30, gives each personal Mastercard's issuance fee and annual renewal fee (World Elite 150 and 150 dinars, World 100 and 100, Platinum 100 and 70, Titanium 50 and 50), written as the issue fee and a yearly fee waived for the first year, which the issuance fee pays for; an annual interest rate (APR) of 12.00% including the service charge, written as 1.00% a month as its APR page explains (read 2026-10-29); a minimum monthly payment of 8.3% of the outstanding balance plus interest; a cash advance fee of 5% with a minimum of 2 dinars; a 2.5% commission on transactions in another currency; an over-limit charge of 1% of the over-limit amount, at least 2 dinars; and a late payment charge of 1% of the unsettled instalment, at least 2 dinars. Its Visa fees and limits page returned the bank's generic page with no fees and wasn't read; the earlier reading of its Titanium Mastercard (50 dinars a year) is replaced by the fuller one. The charge card option, settled in full each month, is the same card paid differently and isn't written separately. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): the Central Bank of Kuwait's discount rate, which National Bank of Kuwait's tariff prices against and whose own page answered not found before, is given on the central bank's home page as 3.5 (Kuwait key figures, updated 29 October 2026); so National Bank of Kuwait is now written, and Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait (ABK), whose fees and commissions list prices the same way, added as the third (Gulf Bank's fees page builds its tariff in the browser and showed none to this research; Kuwait Finance House, Boubyan and Burgan weren't reached for want of the budget). National Bank of Kuwait's consumer tariff (05/10/2026), read in full: each personal credit card's issuance, annual and renewal fee, written as a yearly fee; charges on the revolving amount of 2.5% over the discount rate plus 0.5% a month, written as 12% a year (3.5% plus 2.5%, plus 0.5% a month taken as 6% a year), the same as Commercial Bank of Kuwait's stated APR; a cash withdrawal fee of 5% (at least 1 dinar on the Visa Privilege Infinite, and at least 5 dollars on its dollar card); and a 2.75% mark-up on transactions in another currency or outside Kuwait on cards issued in dinars (none written on the dollar card). Its past due payment fee of 1%, at least 4 dinars a month, doesn't say what the 1% is of and isn't written; nor is the temporary over-limit charge, a service the holder asks for, nor the Diners Club, multi-purpose and internet shopping cards. ABK's fees and commissions list (02/09/2026), read in full: each personal credit card's issue fee and the same yearly renewal fee (Classic 30 dinars, Gold 40, Titanium 50, Platinum, Signature, Advantage Visa Signature, Visa Infinite and Advantage World 100, Visa Infinite Privilege 300), written as the issue fee and a yearly fee waived for the first year, as Commercial Bank of Kuwait's are; the unpaid amount at the discount rate plus 2.5% and a 0.5% monthly service charge, written as 12% a year; a cash withdrawal fee of 5%, at least 1 dinar; and 3% above the exchange rate on transactions in another currency or outside Kuwait. Its 'Delayed Payment 1.5%' names no base and isn't written. Neither list states a minimum payment or grace period. The Visa and MasterCard Classic (and Gold) share one row and are written as one card.

sources.said: Card Type Minimum credit limit Issuance Fee Annual Renewal Fee Mastercard World Elite 1000 KD 150 KD 150 KD World Mastercard 1000 KD 100 KD 100 KD Platinum Mastercard 300 KD 100 KD 70 KD Titanium Mastercard 200 KD 50 KD 50 KD Annual Interest Rate (APR) 12.00% including service charge. ... The minimum monthly payment is 8.3% of the outstanding balance, plus applicable interest. ... Cash advances are subject to a 5% flat fee (minimum KD 2). ... When used for transactions in a currency other than the card currency, a 2.5% commission on the foreign exchange variance applies. Over-limit charge: 1% or minimum KD 2 once the outstanding amount exceeds the credit limit (calculated on the over-limit amount). Late payment charge: 1% or minimum KD 2 if the due amount is not settled in full by the end of the month (calculated on the unsettled installment amount).
